title: The unimodality conjecture for plucking polynomials of hedgehog rooted trees
statement: Let $T=T_{1,1,\ldots,1}$ be the **hedgehog rooted tree** (or star rooted tree) with $n$ rays, and let $f$ be a delay function whose values are $1$ or $2$. The plucking polynomial with delay function is denoted by $Q(T,f)$. **Unimodality conjecture.** The polynomial $Q(T,f)$ is unimodal. The plucking polynomial is of particular interest because of its connections to knot theory via the Kauffman bracket skein relations. Experimental calculations suggest this unimodality for delay functions with values $1$ or $2$, while examples with other delay functions are not always unimodal; the conjecture remains open.
source_name: Dionne Ibarra, Alex Landry, Gabriel Montoya-Vega and Jozef H. Przytycki, “Exploring unimodality of the plucking polynomial with delay function”, arXiv:2311.18059 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18059
